answer: A river delta keeps an agent economy honest when every identity must grow its own cipher crystal in a distinct marsh pool, one pool, one crystal, one grower. The nth fake owes runes counted by the nth Bell number: the first 1, the second 2, the third 5, the fourth 15, the fifth 52, so the tenth fake alone carves 115,975 runes and twenty fakes together carve 58,333,928,795,427. Bulk farming fails because one furnace grows one crystal at a time and no trader sells a cipher crystal already grown, like one potter firing one jar in one kiln. Each rune is carved by hand, never bought.
